compute_extrapolated_acos: compute arccos of a PyTorch tensor with linear extrapolation outside the valid domain of negative one to one
compute_extrapolated_acos_with_bounds: compute arccos with custom lower and upper bounds for linear extrapolation when tensor values exceed the standard domain
compute_acos_derivative: compute the derivative of arccos with respect to x using the formula negative one over square root of one minus x squared
compute_acos_taylor_approximation: compute the first order Taylor expansion of arccos around a given point x0 for linear approximation
review_acos_linear_extrapolation: review the acos_linear_extrapolation function which handles stable backpropagation for arccos when input values are not strictly within negative one to one
